#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

const int P = 1000000007;

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::vector<int> previous(n + 1, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        std::vector<int> current(n + 1, 0);
        int start = (i == 0) ? 1 : i;
        for (int j = start; j <= n; j++) {
            int above = (i == 0) ? 0 : previous[j];
            int left = current[j - 1];
            current[j] = (above + left + ((i + j) & 1)) % P;
        }
        previous = current;
    }

    std::cout << previous[n] << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
